name: Layered range tree with fractional cascading
definition: For a planar range tree node v with sorted y list A_v, define child prefix maps F_c(t)=|{j:0≤j<t and A_v[j] belongs to child c}|. Propagate query slice [s,t) to [F_c(s),F_c(t)) in child c; report slices at canonical x nodes.
variables: A_v ordered record references; c child; F_c prefix rank map; s,t slice bounds
assumptions: Static finite planar records, consistent tie order and closed query bounds; exact admission review pending

name: Persistent sweep planar point location
definition: For nonvertical edge e with endpoints (a,b) and (c,d), a<c, define h_e(x)=b+(d-b)(x-a)/(c-a). For consecutive distinct vertex abscissas X_j<X_(j+1), the active set A_j={e:a≤X_j and X_(j+1)≤c} has a fixed vertical order in the open slab. Maintain a persistent ordered tree T_j of A_j. For X_j<x<X_(j+1) and a query (x,y) off all edges, find the predecessor of y among h_e(x) and return its upper incident face (or the unbounded face below all edges). Event and boundary queries remain outside this provisional open-slab specification.
variables: (a,b),(c,d) ordered edge endpoints; h_e(x) interpolated height; X_j sorted event abscissas; A_j active edges; T_j persistent version; (x,y) query.
assumptions: Finite planar straight-line subdivision with nonvertical edges, disjoint edge interiors, no coincident edges, intersections represented by shared vertices and distinct vertex abscissas; query is within an open slab and off all edges. Incident faces must be consistently labelled. Event and boundary conventions pending admission review.
limitations: Provisional static open-slab point location only; queries at event abscissas, on boundaries or outside the extreme event interval are excluded pending review. Persistent update model, resource bounds and general degeneracy handling still require independent admission review.
failure_conditions: Crossing or coincident edge interiors, inconsistent incident face labels, undefined edge ordering, or queries outside the restricted open-slab domain.
computation: Sort event abscissas; remove terminating edges and insert starting edges at each event using their order immediately to the right. Retain the resulting active tree version. Binary-search the event array for a supported query, then compare y with exact interpolated heights to find the immediately lower edge or identify that none exists. Return its upper face label or the unbounded face. Full implementation and admission review pending.
